reason: Verification failed on multiple critical specification gaps: entity/parameter misalignment, missing core metrics (masked_interaction_fraction, supply_adequacy, policy_effect_size), no adherence probability/fatigue, and unsafe handling of null mandate dates. The code runs, but to meet the Task Specification and enable validation, another iteration is necessary. With 2 iterations remaining, there is significant potential for improvement by aligning entities/parameters, implementing adherence dynamics, and completing required metrics.

specific_areas: Align entities and parameters with the Task Specification (Person with adherence_prob, fatigue_level, mask_quality; PolicyMaker semantics; MediaSource mapping; parameter names like population_size, simulation_days, price_elasticity_of_demand, adherence_decay_rate, etc.)
Implement adherence probability and fatigue dynamics; use Bernoulli sampling for wear events and decay adherence with adherence_decay_rate
Handle mandate_start_day and mandate_end_day when null safely; default to no mandate

Compute required metrics: masked_interaction_fraction, daily supply fraction and overall supply_adequacy, final_adoption_rate, time_to_50_percent_adoption, sustained_adoption_rate, policy_effect_size (pre/post or diff-in-diff), average_adherence
Remove duplicate summarize_metrics and redundant evaluate() calls; centralize metric computation
Integrate price_elasticity_of_demand into purchase behavior; modulate quantity/probability by price
Cap per-agent contacts by max_contacts_per_day and apply workplace_contact_multiplier in contact generation
Harden social network neighbor mapping to avoid ID==index assumption
Instrument aggregator to record per-day metrics needed for summaries and return the full required set in evaluate()
Add headless visualization fallback to save plots instead of show

task_understanding.adjustments: Strictly adhere to the Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation spec. Use canonical entity names/attributes and parameter schema. Map existing components (PolicyCampaign -> PolicyMaker, InformationChannel -> MediaSource) or rename for clarity.

data_analysis.adjustments: Define precise formulas and data sources for each required metric. Ensure signals include contacts and mask states for masked_interaction_fraction, and retailer stock for supply_adequacy. Plan pre/post windows for policy_effect_size.

model_planning.adjustments: Update module plan to include adherence probability dynamics and fatigue, safe policy null handling, price elasticity, contact caps and workplace multipliers, and a robust network ID mapping. Fix daily update order and responsibilities.

code_generation.adjustments: Refactor dataclasses to add missing fields; implement adherence Bernoulli and fatigue updates; guard mandate None; compute and store all required metrics; integrate price elasticity; cap contacts; add explicit graph ID mapping; remove duplicate summarize logic; standardize parameter names.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks/tests for mandate None handling, presence of all required metrics, and correct parameter recognition. Detect duplicate methods and redundant calls. Validate neighbor mapping and contact caps. Smoke-test headless plotting save.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run quick sanity scenarios: no-policy-no-supply, price sensitivity A/B, and with/without enforcement. Use small populations for speed while verifying metric generation and stability.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Report final_adoption_rate, time_to_50_percent_adoption, sustained_adoption_rate, policy_effect_size, supply_adequacy, masked_interaction_fraction, and average_adherence. Check expected directions (e.g., negative price elasticity).

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise diffs and a checklist showing alignment with each spec requirement. Highlight remaining gaps and risks, and quantify improvements in metrics coverage.
